title: Grateful Dead Live at McArthur Court, University of Oregon on 1969-05-31

ai_review.summary: A solid soundboard capture of a legendary ’69 show, highlighted by an epic He Was A Friend Of Mine and soaring Dark Star with generally good audio clarity.
ai_review.review: The recording (soundboard) is clear enough to let the band’s fire shine through, despite a few minor drop‑outs and a truncated ending on Doin’ That Rag. Musically this set is a standout – Jerry’s guitar work on He Was A Friend Of Mine, Baby Blue and Dark Star is repeatedly praised, Bob Weir’s Green Grass ballad and the extended jams on The Other One, Lovelight and Hurts Me Too keep listeners hooked throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews average >4.5 stars; overwhelmingly positive comments about performance with only minor recording complaints, yielding a strong combined show‑and‑recording rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced soundboard mix; occasional drop‑outs and a cut at the end of Doin’ That Rag plus missing final seconds of Cosmic Charlie, but overall listening experience is solid.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
Sitting On Top of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds from a tight first half into a jam‑heavy second half with superb transitions, especially into The Other One and Dark Star; early moments are occasionally rough but the overall flow is energetic and cohesive.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work on He Was A Friend Of Mine, Baby Blue and Dark Star receives high praise; his vocals are noted as emotionally powerful yet occasionally awkward.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir shines on the Green Grass ballad and delivers solid rhythm/vocals throughout.
